# WaveguideCoplanarCurved

The PCell declaration of a curved segment of a coplanar waveguide.

**Source:** KQC (KQCircuits). **Category:** waveguide. **Module:** `kqcircuits.elements.waveguide_coplanar_curved`.

:::{warning}
Legacy cell. the bare arc piece routes are drawn with; unused as a cell. Use a route (its bends). Ports a/b and a line LOM since 2026-11-15
:::

See also the [catalog](../CATALOG.md).

## Pins

![Pins of WaveguideCoplanarCurved](../../images/components/WaveguideCoplanarCurved.png)

Pin image (default parameters). Light = metal, dark = etched gap, colours = junction layers. A red dot and arrow is a pin and its direction (out of the cell); the red bar is the CPW width a + 2 b. Blue dot = a pin without direction. Units: µm.

| pin | x (µm) | y (µm) | direction (°) | a (µm) | b (µm) | purpose |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | 100 | 0 | 270 | 10 | 6 | CPW end; LOM node `line` |
| `b` | -100 | 0 | 270 | 10 | 6 | CPW end; LOM node `line` |

a, b: CPW centre width and gap where the pin declares them (`–` = not declared). Position and direction are in the cell's own frame (`at=(0, 0)`, `rot=0`).

**Notes from the catalog:** origin at the arc centre: port 'a' at (r, 0), 'b' at angle alpha, both facing out along the tangent (registry.KQC_EXTRA_PORTS; KQC draws no ports). LOM: a CPW line of r·\|alpha\|.

## Parameters

| name | default | unit | description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `a` | `10` | μm | Width of center conductor |
| `b` | `6` | μm | Width of gap |
| `r` | `100` | μm | Turn radius |
| `length` | `0` | μm | Actual length |
| `ground_grid_in_trace` | `false` | – | Add ground grid also to the waveguide |
| `alpha` | `3.141592653589793` | – | Curve angle (rad) |
| `add_metal` | `false` | – | Add trace in base metal addition too |

Electrically relevant parameters (sizes, gaps, junction, ports) come first, the rest follows.

## LOM model

The cell contributes to the lumped model:

- no lumped branches

| line | node | length (µm) | a (µm) | b (µm) | ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `X` | `line` | 314.159 | 10 | 6 | short / short |

Nodes: `line`.

## How to use

In Python:

```python
from quantcore_circuits.designer import Designer

d = Designer("demo", box=(0, 0, 7500, 7500))
d.add("U1", "WaveguideCoplanarCurved", at=(3750, 3750), a=10)   # parameters: see the table above
d.add("PAD", "BondPad", at=(1125, 3750), rot=270)   # a launcher to connect to
d.route("L1", "PAD.a", "U1.a")                # a CPW from the pad to the pin
```

Pin names go into `d.route(...)` as `INSTANCE.pin`, and into `snap=` / `to=` when placing. From the shell: `qcc components WaveguideCoplanarCurved` lists the pins; add `--schema` for the parameters.

In KLayout: Quantcore panel ▸ Components ▸ double-click the cell, then click on the layout to place it. Rotate and mirror before the click; use Connect on two pins to route.
